tools.name: list_models

tools.name: list_media_models
tools.description: Every media model on RelaySwitch with its id, kind, endpoint, unit and price per image, second, generation or minute at each setting, next to the developer's price where recorded. No key needed. Live from GET /v1/catalog/media.

tools.name: media_model
tools.description: Everything generate needs to call one image, video, speech, music or 3D model: each setting under params with its type, the values it takes, its range and its default, and the price per unit at each setting under pricing. No key needed. Live from GET /v1/catalog/media.

tools.name: estimate
tools.description: The cost of a request on every chat model (or the ids given), cheapest first, with the developer's list cost and the saving. Give input_tokens, or a prompt / messages to count from. With the caller's key, prices are the key's own (price locks included). Live from POST /v1/estimate.

tools.name: media_quote
tools.description: What generate would charge for exactly these settings, at the key's own rates: the units billed, the charge, and the developer's own price for the same request where one is on record. tools.name: proof
tools.description: Whether each model is still the model it says it is: every day one fixed prompt goes to every model and the verdict per model is stable, changed, failed or unchecked, with the time of the last check and how long the answer has been unchanged. No key needed. Live from GET /v1/proof.

tools.description: Sends the same conversation (or one prompt) to 2 to 5 chat model ids at once through POST /v1/chat/completions and returns every answer side by side with its token usage, cost and time, plus the total. tools.description: One web search through POST /v1/search: titles, URLs, snippets and publish dates, up to 10 results, optionally only from the last day, week, month or year. tools.name: embed
tools.description: Embeds one text or up to 64 through POST /v1/embeddings with an embedding model id from list_models (type embedding) and returns one vector per text, in order, with the token usage and the charge. Billed to the key in the MCP request's Authorization header.

tools.name: rerank
tools.description: Orders up to 100 documents by relevance to a query through POST /v1/rerank with a rerank model id from list_models (type rerank): each result's index into documents, its score and its text, best first. Billed per input token to the key in the MCP request's Authorization header.

tools.name: transcribe
tools.description: Turns the speech in an audio or video file at an https URL (25 MB at most; a file generate made works) into text through POST /v1/audio/transcriptions, or into English with translate. Use a transcription model id from list_models (type transcription). Billed per second of audio to the key in the MCP

tools.name: generation
tools.description: One generation by id: its status, progress, files and charge, waiting up to wait_seconds for it to finish first. Use it after generate answers with a video still running. Needs the key the generation was made with. Live from GET /v1/generations/{id}.

tools.name: generations
tools.description: The organization's generations, newest first, each with its status, model, files and charge: the asset library behind generate. Filter by kind, model or status; page with before. Files are kept 30 days. Needs the key. Live from GET /v1/generations.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: list_models, estimate, chat, search · Private data: list_models, media_quote, chat, compare, embed, rerank, transcribe, generate, generation, generations · Public sink: estimate, media_quote, chat, compare, search, embed, rerank, transcribe, generate.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: list_models, estimate, chat, search · Private data: list_models, media_quote, chat, compare, embed, rerank, transcribe, generate, generation, generations · Public sink: estimate, media_quote, chat, compare, search, embed, rerank, transcribe, generate

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
